inventory: Equestrian gold ring and narrow-striped tunic

encounter.title: The petition for the broad stripe
encounter.objective: Use Denounce and secure the decisive vote backing imperial admission. Issue: Admission, office and constitutional precedent. Interests change the value of each argument; check the preview.

units.name: Crispus’s advocate
units.intent: Attack nearby speakers on even turns; otherwise lobby wavering members.

units.name: Old-order spokesman
units.intent: Defend the old order and its wavering votes.

log: 7 of 13 votes required at the end of turn 14. An early majority does not end the debate; a tie fails.
Move speaker to 4E; one movement, up to three tiles.
Address 5 nearby members: office +1, office +1, service +2, service +2, law +3 stance (commitment resists reversal). Speech spent; available again on turn 4.
Move speaker to 4G; one movement, up to three tiles.
Denounce Old-order spokesman: −4 Resolve (10 → 6). A withdrawn speaker keeps their vote.
Crispus’s advocate challenges Landholders delegate 1 on office: stance −2.
Old-order spokesman challenges Landholders delegate 2 on service: stance −2.
Turn 2. Vote in 13 turns. Current support: 9/13.
Invoke your military record: Landholders delegate 2 stance -1 → 4. Costs one speech. This member can hear your Record only once per Contest. Interest: service.
Denounce Old-order spokesman: −4 Resolve (6 → 2). A withdrawn speaker keeps their vote.
Crispus’s advocate attacks Aurelius Marcellus’s Resolve (−3).
Old-order spokesman attacks Aurelius Marcellus’s Resolve (−3).
Turn 3. Vote in 12 turns. Current support: 10/13.
